title: Phrog Parasite

moves.title: Infect
effects: Add 3 Infection to player's discard pile

notes: Gains Infested Power on spawn. The Infect move adds Infection status cards to the player's discard pile, which act as debuffs by fouling the player's hand with unplayable cards. Alternates between this status move and direct multi-hit attacks with Lash.
